abilities.name: intimidate
abilities.effect: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.

abilities.name: flash-fire
abilities.effect: Protects against fire moves.  Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.

abilities.name: justified
abilities.effect: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a dark move.

kanto.flavorText: It is very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

original-johto.flavorText: It controls a big territory. If it detects an unknown smell, it roars loudly to force out the intruder.

hoenn.flavorText: Its superb sense of smell ensures that this POKéMON won’t forget any scent, no matter what. It uses its sense of smell to detect the emotions of others.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

updated-johto.flavorText: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

original-unova.flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

updated-unova.flavorText: Extremely loyal to its Trainer, it will bark at those who approach the Trainer unexpectedly and run them out of town.

kalos.flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Growlithe has a superb sense of smell. Once it smells anything, this Pokémon won’t forget the scent, no matter what. It uses its advanced olfactory sense to determine the emotions of other living things.

original-alola.flavorText: It looks cute, but when you approach another Trainer’s Growlithe, it will bark at you and bite.

updated-alola.flavorText: It has lived alongside humans since ages ago. Its bones have been found in excavations of ruins from the Stone Age.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: A Pokémon with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.

swsh.flavorText: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

freeTextEntries: Grand Underground - Spacious Cave, Volcanic Cave, Sandsear Cave, Typhlo Cavern (After obtaining the National Pokédex)

pla.flavorText: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.
